name: jgrandson-monorepo
description: JGrandson: a personal productivity language that compiles to React + TypeScript.

scripts.preview: node packages/cli/bin/jg.js build examples/landing.jg --out=my-app/src/jg && npm --prefix my-app run build && npm --prefix my-app run preview -- --host
scripts.publish:packages: npm publish --workspace @jgrandson/ast && npm publish --workspace @jgrandson/lexer && npm publish --workspace @jgrandson/parser && npm publish --workspace @jgrandson/analyzer && npm publish --workspace @jgrandson/compiler && npm publish --workspace @jgrandson/cli && npm publish --workspace @jgrandson/language-server && npm publish --workspace @jgrandson/runtime

author: JGrandson Team <team@jgrandson.dev>
